# Branches

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** api + web  
**Status:** shipped

## Purpose

The places a clinic operates from. One organization, one or many branches — a solo clinic and a hospital group are the same shape.

## Features

- Branch CRUD with a tenant-qualified `code`
- Weekly operating hours with per-day slot minutes
- Closure dates
- Soft delete via `deletedAt`, never a boolean

## User actions

- Open a branch
- Edit branch details and GST number
- Set the opening-hours week strip
- Retire a branch

## Known limitations

- Closures are modelled but no screen manages them
- `branch_operating_hours` and `branch_closures` have no `organization_id`; they are protected by a parent-scoped RLS policy through `branches`
